compliance: Structure/function claims only: 'supports', 'helps maintain', 'may support'. Never diagnose, treat, cure, prevent, reverse, heal, manage a condition (DSHEA rollout doc, 2026-09-21).
Never name a disease or medical condition in headline or body.
No doctors, no celebrities, no invented experts or institutions.
No fake testimonials presented as real; no stat without a real source and its footnote.
No body before/after presented as a real customer.
Never say it replaces a medication or that someone should stop a medication.

Disclaimer slot (only where the template has the slot, short DSHEA version): 'These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.'
[TO CONFIRM] 'Results may vary' allowed as a footnote where the template carries one.
